question: Those who have questions concerning fringe benefits are advised to consult ____ employee handbook.
explanation: Cần tính từ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ employee handbook: their.

question: The two divisions have unveiled ____ plan to set aside millions of dollars to invest in a very lucrative field.
explanation: Đứng trước danh từ plan cần tính từ sở hữu their.

question: Mr. Kurt Spienza appears to be the only person in our team who can finish the survey by ____.
explanation: Cụm by himself nghĩa là tự mình; đại từ phản thân phù hợp với chủ ngữ Mr. Kurt Spienza.

question: It seems that laborers in underdeveloped countries would rather have their children help ____ at work than enroll them in school.
explanation: Help là ngoại động từ; tân ngữ chỉ những người lao động là them.

question: ____ remain complicated economic problems to be resolved, while the economic conditions have been good.
explanation: Dùng cấu trúc There remain + danh từ số nhiều để nói vẫn còn những vấn đề cần giải quyết.

question: Considering the failure of ____ system to offer adequate support, we might have to provide refunds to our customers.
explanation: Đứng trước danh từ system cần tính từ sở hữu our.

question: Our skilled and experienced service representatives will be able to resolve any problems you might encounter by ____.
explanation: Chủ ngữ representatives số nhiều; by themselves nghĩa là tự họ.

question: Ms. Cordova was struggling to successfully complete the task assigned to her by ____.
explanation: Sau giới từ by cần đại từ phản thân herself.

question: The report shows that builders reserve the right to control the volume of the construction project on ____ own.
explanation: Cụm cố định on their own nghĩa là tự mình/tự họ.

question: The company is going to carry out the proposal based on the information provided in your letter of intent, so please submit ____ application under this note.
explanation: Đứng trước danh từ application cần tính từ sở hữu your.

question: As soon as the shipment of computer equipment comes in, ____ will ship it to you promptly.
explanation: Chỗ trống làm chủ ngữ của will ship nên dùng đại từ chủ ngữ we.

question: The head of the marketing department attributed success in the overseas market to ____ motivated and hard-working employees.
explanation: Đứng trước cụm danh từ employees cần tính từ sở hữu its.

question: Drivers are required to carry ____ liability insurance policy at all times in their cars in case of an accident.
explanation: Đứng trước danh từ policy cần tính từ sở hữu their.

question: ____ habitually answers incoming phone calls and signs for packages while in the office.
explanation: Chỗ trống làm chủ ngữ của answers và signs nên dùng She.

question: If you have difficulty preparing for a presentation on ____, ask Mr. Jacobs for help.
explanation: Cụm on your own nghĩa là tự mình.

question: In order for ____ to provide the necessary benefits, dentists associated with the university's insurance policies must be shown a valid student ID card.
explanation: Sau giới từ for cần đại từ tân ngữ them.

question: Mr. Fisher prefers to do his small company's bookkeeping ____ instead of hiring an accountant.
explanation: Do ... himself nhấn mạnh ông Fisher tự làm việc kế toán.

question: Only ____ with a renewed membership card may attend the concert.
explanation: Those thay cho những người có thẻ thành viên đã gia hạn.

question: ____ of the proposed plans by the chamber of commerce involves an annual agricultural exhibition.
explanation: Cấu trúc One of + cụm danh từ số nhiều dùng động từ số ít involves.

question: Mr. Whatley unintentionally took Ms. Potvin's timetable, thinking it was ____.
explanation: His là đại từ sở hữu, thay cho his timetable.
